controller_hook: swe2_watchdog.py --loop calls progress_report.py auto every 1800s of controller time; the generator itself skips regeneration when the input fingerprint is unchanged AND the output set is coherent AND no .dirty mark is present; the watchdog consumes .dirty only on a zero exit code

freshness.coherent_capture: inputs fingerprinted before AND after the build; a mid-build move aborts the generation
freshness.output_set: all five files staged to temp, then committed as one generation with snapshot.json last; a commit failure leaves the prior generation's fingerprint on the authoritative member, and check() rejects any mixed set
freshness.dirty_mark: _index/progress/.dirty - touched by publish_paths.sh on any committed document change; forces regeneration regardless of fingerprint; consumed by the watchdog ONLY on a successful run
freshness.stale_rule: on missing/unreadable required inputs the run fails INCOMPLETE: snapshot.json names the missing inputs and the last good output set is kept - never empty CURRENT counts
freshness.history_rule: history.jsonl records successful publications only, one row per fingerprint; failed candidates and duplicate triggers are not recorded
freshness.terminal_evidence: final_audits is read from the PROGRAM-STATE receipted counter plus AUDIT-LOG complete-run entries; AUDIT-PASS* files are per-round artefacts and are never summed as passes
freshness.live_rule: a LIVE cell satisfies only where its own text cites the governing L2 ruling; bare LIVE is reported LIVE-UNRULED and never folds into MET
freshness.parity_rule: PARITY-STATUS.md 'N of M pilots certified'; absent or unparseable is UNMEASURED, never PASS

instruments_used_not_reimplemented: check_questions.classify (vendored port kept as fallback; test asserts row-agreement)
notes: no LLM call, no full audit, no Tools/ input content path (instrument versions are fingerprinted); staged atomic output set; deltas from history.jsonl
